authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full varṣati explicitly gives Khowar boṣik to rain. The six bośīk/boṣīk survey responses fit this verb directly even though the elicitation gloss is rain. Preserve the source gloss and infinitive ending; do not treat it as the separate Kalasha bāṣik noun. Cross-IA transmission is qualified. Exact response: bośīk.
